title: Specify duration and editing constraints in the prompt (e.g....
content:
Specify duration and editing constraints in the prompt (e.g., 15s, one continuous shot, no cuts) to force a single-take sequence.  
Define camera movement and lens explicitly (e.g., single continuous low tracking move, 35mm spherical lens throughout) to stabilize cinematography.  
Constrain framing to avoid unwanted content (e.g., never show faces; show subjects only from neck down/hands) to control composition.  
Use composition directives (e.g., floor-level extreme close-up, subject on right, keep negative space on left) to lock blocking and framing.  
Add “keep [object] centered” and “camera stays locked on [hand/envelope]” instructions to maintain subject tracking across actions.  
Write the action as a beat-by-beat shot plan (close-up → tight close-up → medium close-up → follow shot) while reiterating “same camera” to preserve continuity without cuts.  
Include sound design cues (SFX room tone, paws on wood, collar jingle, paper crinkle, gunshots) to guide timing and realism.  
Specify color treatment (e.g., Naturalistic Film Print Emulation) to steer grading and overall look.
description:
Seedance 2.0 Prompt:

FORMAT: 15s / ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT / NO CUTS
TECHNICAL: Single continuous low tracking move. 35mm spherical lens throughout.

SUBJECTS: Two people and one cat. A barefoot woman in a thin nightgown, shown only from the neck down, with well-groomed bare feet and hands painted with glossy red nail polish. A man shown only through his hands, one with a large ring engraved with an 'X'. A cat wearing a collar with a small key.
ENVIRONMENT: Dusty backroom, sunlit wooden floor, weathered cabinet. The woman stands with her back to the cabinet. The man stands in front of her, facing her. Floorboards are scratched and bright with hard afternoon light.
MOOD: Quiet tension, then sudden violence.
COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation

SCENE:
Extreme close-up. Floor-level camera frames the woman's bare feet and the hem of her nightgown. She is on the right side of frame. Negative space stays on the left. A cat walks into that empty space and brushes her ankle. A small key hangs from its collar. Start low and hold this angle. Never show faces. SFX: (room tone, soft paws on wood, faint collar jingle).
Close-up. She bends down and takes the key from the cat's collar. The same camera rises with her hand and keeps the key centered. It stays below shoulder level. Keep her face out of frame. SFX: (light metal jingle, bare foot shift, fabric brush).
Tight close-up. She gives the key to the man. His 'X' ring catches the light. He takes the key, reaches into his jacket, and pulls out a thick brown envelope. He offers the envelope to her. The same camera slides forward with the key, then stays on the hands and shifts to the envelope. SFX: (metal click, coat rustle, stiff paper crinkle).
Medium close-up. She takes the envelope and turns back to the cabinet behind her. The camera turns with her in the same move and stays locked on the envelope until she opens the cabinet and puts it inside. SFX: (hinges creaking, paper settling on wood).
Action follow shot. Her hand leaves the envelope and takes the handgun from the same cabinet. The camera stays locked on her hand, then whips with that hand as she turns back to the man. She fires. SFX: (metal slide clatter, gunshots, violent room echo). Muzzle flash cuts through the sunlight.

es.title: Especifica la duración y las restricciones de edición en el
es.content:
Especifica la duración y las restricciones de edición en el prompt (por ejemplo, 15s, una toma continua, sin cortes) para forzar una secuencia de una sola toma.  
Define el movimiento de cámara y el lente explícitamente (por ejemplo, un único movimiento de seguimiento bajo continuo, lente esférico de 35mm en todo momento) para estabilizar la cinematografía.  
Restringe el encuadre para evitar contenido no deseado (por ejemplo, nunca mostrar caras; mostrar sujetos solo desde el cuello hacia abajo/manos) para controlar la composición.  
Usa directrices de composición (por ejemplo, primer plano extremo a nivel del suelo, sujeto a la derecha, mantener espacio negativo a la izquierda) para fijar el bloqueo y el encuadre.  
Añade instrucciones como “mantener [objeto] centrado” y “la cámara permanece fija en [mano/sobre]” para mantener el seguimiento del sujeto a través de las acciones.  
Escribe la acción como un plan de tomas paso a paso (primer plano → primerísimo primer plano → plano medio → toma de seguimiento) mientras reiteras “misma cámara” para preservar la continuidad sin cortes.  
Incluye indicaciones de diseño de sonido (SFX tono de la habitación, patas sobre madera, tintineo de collar, crujido de papel, disparos) para guiar el tiempo y el realismo.  
Especifica el tratamiento de color (por ejemplo, Emulación de Impresión de Película Naturalista) para dirigir la gradación y el aspecto general.

fr.title: Spécifiez la durée et les contraintes de montage dans le pro
fr.content:
Spécifiez la durée et les contraintes de montage dans le prompt (par exemple, 15s, une prise continue, pas de coupures) pour imposer une séquence en une seule prise.  
Définissez explicitement le mouvement de la caméra et l'objectif (par exemple, un mouvement de suivi continu bas, objectif sphérique 35mm tout au long) pour stabiliser la cinématographie.  
Contraignez le cadrage pour éviter le contenu indésirable (par exemple, ne jamais montrer de visages ; montrer les sujets uniquement du cou vers le bas/les mains) pour contrôler la composition.  
Utilisez des directives de composition (par exemple, gros plan extrême au niveau du sol, sujet à droite, garder l'espace négatif à gauche) pour verrouiller le placement et le cadrage.  
Ajoutez des instructions telles que « garder [objet] centré » et « la caméra reste fixée sur [main/enveloppe] » pour maintenir le suivi du sujet à travers les actions.  
Écrivez l'action comme un plan de prise par prise (gros plan → gros plan serré → plan moyen serré → plan de suivi) tout en réitérant « même caméra » pour préserver la continuité sans coupures.  
Incluez des indications de conception sonore (SFX ambiance de la pièce, pattes sur bois, tintement de collier, froissement de papier, coups de feu) pour guider le timing et le réalisme.  
Spécifiez le traitement des couleurs (par exemple, Émulation de Tirage de Film Naturaliste) pour orienter l'étalonnage et l'apparence générale.

ja.title: プロンプトで持続時間と編集制約を指定します（例：15秒、ワンカット、カットなし）で、ワンテイクシークエンスを強制します。
ja.content:
プロンプトで持続時間と編集制約を指定します（例：15秒、ワンカット、カットなし）で、ワンテイクシークエンスを強制します。  
カメラの動きとレンズを明確に定義します（例：単一の連続した低いトラッキングムーブ、35mm球面レンズを通して）で、撮影を安定させます。  
フレーミングを制約して不要なコンテンツを避けます（例：顔を決して見せない；首から下/手のみを見せる）で、構図を制御します。  
構図の指示を使用します（例：床レベルの極端なクローズアップ、右側の被写体、左側にネガティブスペースを保つ）で、ブロッキングとフレーミングを固定します。  
「[オブジェクト]を中央に保つ」や「カメラは[手/封筒]に固定される」指示を追加して、アクション全体で被写体の追跡を維持します。  
アクションをビートごとのショットプランとして書きます（クローズアップ→タイトクローズアップ→ミディアムクローズアップ→フォローショット）で、「同じカメラ」を繰り返し、カットなしで連続性を保ちます。  
サウンドデザインのキューを含めます（SFXルームトーン、木の上の足音、首輪の音、紙のクシャクシャ音、銃声）で、タイミングとリアリズムをガイドします。  
色の処理を指定します（例：ナチュラリスティックフィルムプリントエミュレーション）で、グレーディングと全体のルックを導きます。  
---

ko.content:
프롬프트에 지속 시간과 편집 제약 조건을 명시하세요 (예: 15초, 하나의 연속 촬영, 컷 없음)하여 단일 테이크 시퀀스를 강제합니다.  
카메라 움직임과 렌즈를 명확하게 정의하세요 (예: 단일 연속 저속 트래킹 이동, 전체 35mm 구면 렌즈)하여 촬영을 안정화합니다.  
구도를 제한하여 원치 않는 콘텐츠를 피하세요 (예: 얼굴을 절대 보여주지 않음; 목 아래/손만 보여줌)하여 구성을 제어합니다.  
구성 지시를 사용하세요 (예: 바닥 수준의 극단적 클로즈업, 오른쪽에 주제, 왼쪽에 여백 유지)하여 블로킹과 구도를 고정합니다.  
"keep [object] centered"와 "camera stays locked on [hand/envelope]" 지시를 추가하여 행동 전반에 걸쳐 주제 추적을 유지합니다.  
행동을 비트별 촬영 계획으로 작성하세요 (클로즈업 → 타이트 클로즈업 → 미디엄 클로즈업 → 팔로우 샷)하면서 "same camera"를 반복하여 컷 없이 연속성을 유지합니다.  
타이밍과 현실감을 안내하기 위해 사운드 디자인 큐를 포함하세요 (SFX room tone, paws on wood, collar jingle, paper crinkle, gunshots).  
색상 처리(예: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation)를 지정하여 색보정과 전체적인 외관을 조정합니다.

pt-BR.title: Especifique a duração e as restrições de edição no prompt (p
pt-BR.content:
Especifique a duração e as restrições de edição no prompt (por exemplo, 15s, uma tomada contínua, sem cortes) para forçar uma sequência de um único take.  
Defina o movimento da câmera e a lente explicitamente (por exemplo, movimento contínuo de rastreamento baixo, lente esférica de 35mm ao longo) para estabilizar a cinematografia.  
Restrinja o enquadramento para evitar conteúdo indesejado (por exemplo, nunca mostrar rostos; mostrar sujeitos apenas do pescoço para baixo/mãos) para controlar a composição.  
Use diretrizes de composição (por exemplo, close-up extremo ao nível do chão, sujeito à direita, mantenha espaço negativo à esquerda) para fixar o bloqueio e o enquadramento.  
Adicione instruções como “mantenha [objeto] centralizado” e “câmera permanece fixa em [mão/envelope]” para manter o rastreamento do sujeito durante as ações.  
Escreva a ação como um plano de filmagem passo a passo (close-up → close-up apertado → close-up médio → plano de acompanhamento) enquanto reitera “mesma câmera” para preservar a continuidade sem cortes.  
Inclua dicas de design de som (SFX tom ambiente, patas na madeira, tilintar de coleira, amassar de papel, tiros) para guiar o tempo e o realismo.  
Especifique o tratamento de cor (por exemplo, Emulação de Impressão de Filme Naturalista) para direcionar a gradação e o visual geral.

zh-CN.title: 在提示中指定时长和编辑限制（例如，15秒，一个连续镜头，无剪辑）以强制单镜头序列。
zh-CN.content:
在提示中指定时长和编辑限制（例如，15秒，一个连续镜头，无剪辑）以强制单镜头序列。  
明确定义相机运动和镜头（例如，单一连续低位跟踪移动，始终使用35mm球面镜头）以稳定电影摄影。  
限制构图以避免不需要的内容（例如，永远不显示面部；仅显示从颈部以下/手部的主体）以控制构图。  
使用构图指令（例如，地面级极近景，主体在右侧，左侧保持负空间）来锁定阻挡和构图。  
添加“保持[物体]居中”和“相机保持锁定在[手/信封]”的指令，以在动作中保持主体跟踪。  
将动作写成逐拍镜头计划（近景→紧近景→中近景→跟拍镜头），同时重申“同一相机”以在不剪辑的情况下保持连续性。  
包括声音设计提示（SFX房间音调，爪子在木头上，项圈叮当声，纸张皱褶声，枪声）以指导时机和现实感。  
指定色彩处理（例如，自然电影打印仿真）以引导调色和整体外观。
